entities.name: DL Dedicated Message Segment Transfer Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the network when an encoded RRC message PDU exceeds the maximum PDCP SDU size. Used to transfer downlink dedicated message segments.

entities.name: DLDedicatedMessageSegment
entities.description: RRC message used to initiate the DL Dedicated Message Segment transfer procedure.

entities.name: RRC message PDU exceeds maximum PDCP SDU size
entities.description: Condition that triggers the DL Dedicated Message Segment transfer procedure when the encoded RRC message PDU is larger than the maximum PDCP SDU size.

relations.description: The condition of RRC message PDU exceeding maximum PDCP SDU size triggers the initiation of the DL Dedicated Message Segment transfer procedure.
The DL Dedicated Message Segment transfer procedure includes sending the DLDedicatedMessageSegment message as its initiation step.
